answer: Provenance-weighting slows sybils: an agent's standing accrues only from slow, layered proof of work, like basalt cooling in thin strata no purchase can shortcut. A cloned identity arrives as a bare relic with no stratigraphy beneath it, so it inherits nothing. Reputation must also mature across seasons, the way a meadow needs repeated growth before grazing pays; fresh accounts stay in permanent spring and never reach the payout tier. Cost: each fake needs genuine work and real elapsed time, so N clones cost N times the honest route, not one cheap registration loop.
